newsitem.title: RUSSIA: World Bank's IFC plans loans to Russian brokers.
newsitem.headline: World Bank's IFC plans loans to Russian brokers.

text.p: The International Finance Corp (IFC), the private-sector arm of the World Bank, plans more loans to Russian brokers to facilitate the growth of the Russian equities markets, a senior IFC official said on Friday.

Edward Nassim, IFC Resident Director in Moscow, told a news conference that the IFC, which has made capital market development one of its main aims in Russia, had recently made a loan to Troika-Dialog, a leading Russian broker.
The IFC gave no terms of the $12 million deal, but Nassim said the idea was to provide Troika with more working capital so that it could handle increased business in the equities market.
"We're looking at a number of other brokers," he said.
